class.name: NNBTPassThrough
class.brief_description: Runs an optional [method on_tick] hook before ticking its child and returning the child's status.
class.description: Use to run side-effect setup or refresh blackboard values (such as distances or target info) right before a branch executes, without affecting the child's return status. If you need a standalone side-effect step inside a sequence without wrapping a child, use [NNBTPassBy] instead.

method.name: on_tick
method.description: Optional hook called before ticking the child.
